items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And we had a trombone player named Smitty, Carter Smith, Trombone Smitty they called him.

ctx.x: What sort of trumpet player was he, like a first man?

No, no, he wasn't a first trumpet. Well, we all played first. He wasn't a strong trumpet player. And we had a trombone player named Smitty, Carter Smith, Trombone Smitty they called him. Good trombone player.
